title: Social posting calendar, Diwali 2026
intro: For Travaholic's approval. 20 items from 28 Sep to 30 Oct: 15 Instagram posts and 5 ad launches, all from Travaholic's own cap photography, with captions in Travaholic's voice. Posts publish to Instagram at 9am on the day. It builds toward the Diwali gifting push (19 to 29 Oct).
introContinued: Diwali gifting week and the last order-by date. Copy rules on every item: no discount claims, no Cash on Delivery, free shipping on prepaid orders; the only offer is Buy 3, Get 1 Free.

boxes.title: How often, and why
boxes.text: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri: three organic posts and one ad launch every week, 20 items in five weeks. Open days take customer photos and reels as they come in. The account is in Meta's learning phase, so the feed stays steady rather than spiky.

boxes.title: The evidence
boxes.text: 24 months of Meta history: ₹2.99 lakh spent, 594 purchases, 3.39x overall. Catalog ads optimised for purchase, shown to men 18 to 44, ran at 4 to 5x. The buyer is a man aged 18 to 44: 95% of purchases. Women-only ad sets never converted profitably.

boxes.title: What leads
boxes.text: Bestsellers first (Junglee, Black, City Slicker Black), then place-named caps and seasonal hooks (treks, open roads, desert), then Diwali gifting from 19 Oct with Buy 3 Get 1 Free as the only offer. No discount claims, no COD.

boxes.title: Tests
boxes.text: Each Thursday ad launch runs as a creative test inside the one managed campaign, promoting that week's post. Audience tests line up beside them: Top Cities 1 Oct, Lookalike 1 to 3% 8 Oct, Advantage+ Broad 15 Oct. At most one new test a week.

performance.intro: One managed campaign, ₹1,000 a day hard cap, budget at campaign level so Meta shifts spend to whichever ad set is converting. Target 4x return on ad spend, which means a cost per order of ₹350 or less at ₹1,399. Based on the live ad account: 24 months, ₹2.99 lakh spent, 594 purchases, 3.39x overall.

campaigns.name: Interests
campaigns.audience: Men 18 to 44, streetwear, baseball cap, hat and travel interests, India
campaigns.creative: Catalog product ad; each Thursday's ad launch joins as a creative test
campaigns.why: The only ad set above 2x in the last 10 days before the reset (2.62x, 2.7% CTR), now narrowed to the buyer. Since 24 Sep: ₹796, 210 clicks, 2 orders.

campaigns.name: UGC reel
campaigns.creative: The page's best-engaged customer video as a Shop Now ad
campaigns.why: First video ever tested on the account. Since 24 Sep: ₹423, 63 clicks, 0 orders; not judged before ₹2,000 of spend.

campaigns.name: Retargeting
campaigns.audience: Site visitors 30 days, add-to-carts, Instagram engagers 365 days; purchasers excluded
campaigns.creative: Catalog ad; the Diwali gifting ad from 22 Oct
campaigns.why: The account had no retargeting at all before 24 Sep. Since then: ₹1,125, 275 clicks, 32 carts, 1 order; the warmest audience for gifting week.

campaigns.name: Test: Top Cities
campaigns.audience: Same interest stack, delivery limited to the 12 metros that gave ~70% of delivered orders
campaigns.expected: tests geo density vs national reach
campaigns.why: 1,000 past customers cluster in 12 metros; buyer-dense and courier-friendly, at higher CPMs.

campaigns.name: Test: Lookalike 1 to 3%
campaigns.sub: Seeded from past customers · Men 18 to 44
campaigns.audience: 1 to 3% lookalike of 1,800 past buyers, men 18 to 44
campaigns.why: Past buyers are the strongest signal the account has and were never used as a seed. Waiting on Travaholic to accept Meta's Custom Audience terms.

campaigns.name: Test: Advantage+ Broad
campaigns.audience: Meta's own audience expansion, restricted to men 18 to 44
campaigns.why: Once the pixel has fresh purchase signal from the ad sets above.

totals.label: Budget per week (₹1,000 a day hard cap, moved between ad sets by Meta)
totals.why: At ₹350 per order that is about 100 orders over five weeks. A target from the account's history, not a forecast.

boxes.title: What this buys
boxes.html:
Up to ₹35,000 of ad spend over five weeks, 28 Sep to 30 Oct, never more than ₹1,000 a day.

At the 4x target that is ₹1.4 lakh of ad-attributed sales, before organic, WhatsApp and repeat orders. Peak spend sits in gifting week, 19 to 29 Oct.

boxes.title: Rules the system runs by, automatically
items: Nothing is judged before ₹2,000 of spend on an ad set.
7-day return 5x or more (6+ orders): scale +20%, within the ₹1,000 cap.
4 to 5x: hold, so learning is not reset.
2 to 4x: cut that ad set's share and swap its creative.
Under 2x: pause it and launch the next test. Budget moves at most once every 72 hours.
The whole campaign pauses only if real site revenue ÷ ad spend is under 4x for a week.
Checked every morning at 8am by DevShop Retail OS; every change is logged. Nothing goes live without Travaholic's written approval.
